stories.summary: Iran has intensified attacks on US bases and civilian sites in the Gulf after a lull, while the US naval blockade and sanctions squeeze it. stories.headline: Turkish Air Force helicopter crashes after Eskişehir takeoff
stories.summary: A Turkish Air Force AS-532 helicopter crashed after taking off from Eskişehir during a training flight, and search and rescue operations are underway.
stories.turkey: A loss of military aircraft and personnel in a training accident.

stories.headline: Europe gas storage at 69% ahead of winter, prices jump
stories.summary: European natural gas storage fell to 69% full, with prices rising up to 8.6% in one day.
stories.turkey: Tight European gas supply raises Türkiye's value as a gas hub but also exposes it to price swings.

stories.headline: Cyprus talks: emergency mechanism agreed, crossings stalled; Israel gas talks advance
stories.summary: Christodoulides and Erhürman agreed text for a bicommunal emergency response mechanism but not on more crossing points. Israel's ambassador said talks on the Aphrodite-Ishai gas field could conclude within months, and Cyprus remains committed to the Great Sea Interconnector.
stories.turkey: Cyprus-Israel energy cooperation and the interconnector bear on Türkiye's Eastern Mediterranean position.

stories.headline: Leaked data puts Russian war dead at about 720,000
stories.summary: Leaked Rosstat data authenticated by Mediazona and Meduza puts Russian soldier deaths at about 720,000, showing strain on working-age men. Ukraine's General Staff reports record Russian casualties this year.
